entities.summary: Alfonso Carlos Romo Garza, known as Alfonso Romo, is a Monterrey businessman, agro-industrialist. He founded the Opción Ciudadana party in 2005. He is the owner of VECTOR Casa de Bolsa, the largest fund management company in Latin America.
